entries.content: Ki also known as chi, is the life force energy. This force is a tangible energy inside every living being, with its major focus being in the center of the body. By drawing it out, an individual is able to manipulate it and use it outside the body. Ki can be used for many different fighting techniques.

Ki Blasts are formed and discharged portions of ki which are frequently used for fighting. The most iconic Ki Blast is the Kamehameha which is Goku's favorite finishing move. It is the most basic form of ranged attack available to any fighter who is able to channel their ki in battle. The range of techniques in this category is vast, they can be released in various forms such as spherical bullets, focused lasers, huge continuous beams, can cause concussive, explosive, slicing, burning or vaporising damage.

Super Saiyan is an advanced transformation utilized by members and hybrids of the Saiyan race. Earthlings with Saiyan heritage can also assume the transformation by wishing to have their dormant Saiyan powers unlocked. Super Saiyan makes the user glow of a golden light, their hair become spiky and golden, their eyes a vivd blue color. Their power level increases tenfold in this form. At the second transformation Super Saiyan 2 the user who transforms has an increased golden aura around their body and electric discharges happening all around their chest and legs, their speed and strength increase a lot again. Super Saiyan 3 is the last form where the user grows hair beyond their back and their eyebrows disappear, it is the strongest form so far.

Big Bang Attack is an energy sphere shot by Vegeta through his open palms. In order to perform it, Vegeta extends his arm, opens his palm and turns his hand up right. He then condenses his ki in his palm and launches a ki blast that proceeds to detonate in a massive explosion.

Garlick Gun is an energy wave used by Vegeta. To utilize it Vegeta curls his fingers and places both his hands together at chest level facing the same direction (so that the palm of one hand is on the back of the other). Then he shouts "Galick Gun!" and thrusts both hands forward to fire a powerful blast of energy. The result is a powerful, huge, fuchsia-colored ki beam that emanates from his hands and body. It is capable of destroying large planets if enough power is put into it.

Final Flash is an energy wave used by Vegeta. The Final Flash is formed by throwing both arms open, hands held vertically and fingers wide while gathering ki. Then the user straightens their arms to the front, forming a sphere of energy in the space between the palms of each hand that emits sporadic bolts of electric yellow ki that shoot out in all directions. Finally, the user discharges a massive golden beam of energy with electric ki streaming around it towards his opponent. The scope of the attack can be varied from just a medium-sized straight blast to a super-charged fully powered variant huge enough to be seen in space.

Earthlings are the inhabitants of planet Earth. The term is used to refer to all of the intelligent races native to the planet, including humans, anthropomorphs, monsters. Earthlings are among the weakest races in the universe with the average human's power level way below that of a Saiyan. Only a few Earthlings show a reasonable aptitude in martial arts on the galactic scale.

Capsule Corporation is a company founded and run by Dr. Brief who is Bulma's father. The corporation is based around and takes its name from the Hoi-Poi Capsules invented by Dr. Brief himself. The Capsule Corporation headquarters which is also the Brief family's home is located in West City. The building and the surrounding area is large enough to house a small country. Vegeta and Bulma live there in a private round-shaped home with a large spacious bedroom.
